apps.name: Focus Timer
apps.tagline: A clean Pomodoro timer with a progress ring and session counter.
apps.description: A distraction-free Pomodoro timer. Work in 25-minute focus blocks, take 5-minute breaks, and get a longer break after every fourth session. A progress ring shows time left at a glance, and the window title keeps counting so you can follow it from the taskbar.
features: Focus, short break and long break modes
Start, pause, reset and skip, or just press Space
Countdown shown in the window title

apps.name: Password Generator
apps.tagline: Generate strong random passwords and copy them in one click.
apps.description: Generate strong random passwords with Python's cryptographically secure secrets module. Choose the length and character sets, copy with one click, and see an entropy-based strength estimate. Nothing is stored or sent anywhere.
features: Upper, lower, digits and symbols toggles
Optional filter for look-alike characters (I, l, 1, O, 0, o)
One-click copy; clipboard clears after 30 seconds if unchanged

apps.name: Typing Speed Test
apps.tagline: 30 seconds, live feedback, WPM and accuracy with a saved best score.
apps.description: A 30-second typing speed test with live per-letter feedback. See your words per minute and accuracy, and track your personal best across sessions.
features: Timer starts on your first keystroke
Green and red feedback for every character
